text: Understanding databases is essential for modern software development. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them highly organised. To retrieve information, developers write queries using languages like SQL. Good data modelling helps you plan the structure of your tables before you start building. Indexes are another important feature because they make searches much faster, especially when a table contains a lot of records. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, offer more flexibility for unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
